title: Clinical Trials & Individual Participant Data
blurb: Trial registries and platforms that share individual participant data from completed trials.

items.name: ClinicalTrials.gov
items.description: Registry and results database of >500,000 clinical studies in 220+ countries, with a modern REST API and bulk downloads.
items.access_note: Open web, API and bulk download.

paper.label: Zarin DA et al. N Engl J Med 2011;364:852

items.name: AACT
items.description: A relational (PostgreSQL) copy of the entire ClinicalTrials.gov database refreshed daily, ideal for research on trial design and reporting.
items.access_note: Flat files and database dumps open; free account needed for the live cloud database.

paper.label: Tasneem A et al. PLoS One 2012;7:e33677

items.name: WHO ICTRP
items.description: Single search portal over primary trial registries worldwide (incl. CTRI, ChiCTR, EU CTR, ISRCTN, ANZCTR, PACTR).
items.access_note: Open search; full data export on request.

items.name: Vivli
items.description: Independent non-profit platform to search and request de-identified individual participant data from 7,000+ trials contributed by pharma, academia and funders (now also hosting GSK's former CSDR requests).
items.access_note: Research proposal reviewed by the data contributor; analysis in a secure research environment. Generally free for academic requestors.

paper.label: Bierer BE et al. N Engl J Med 2016;374:2411

items.name: YODA Project
items.description: Independent review and sharing of individual participant data from trials contributed by Johnson & Johnson, Medtronic, Procter & Gamble and others.
items.access_note: Free; research proposal reviewed by YODA; analysis in a secure platform.

items.name: Project Data Sphere
items.description: Open platform sharing patient-level data from oncology trial comparator (and some experimental) arms, with built-in analytics tools.
items.provider: Project Data Sphere / CEO Roundtable on Cancer
items.access_note: Free registration and acceptance of the data-sharing agreement.

items.name: NCTN/NCORP Data Archive
items.description: Individual-level data from completed NCI-funded cancer clinical trials run by US cooperative groups.
items.access_note: Free; data request with signed data use agreement.

items.name: NIDA Data Share
items.description: De-identified data from completed trials of the NIDA Clinical Trials Network on substance-use disorder treatments.
items.provider: US National Institute on Drug Abuse
items.access_note: Free download after accepting the data-sharing agreement online.
